description: Client requirements and design parameters for one test fit. Every default is a placeholder.

project.description: Project name for title blocks and file names
project.title: Project

it_load_mw.description: Total IT load of the building, MW
it_load_mw.title: It Load Mw

hall_it_mw.description: IT load per data hall, MW (number of halls = it_load_mw / hall_it_mw, rounded up)
hall_it_mw.title: Hall It Mw

storeys.description: Data hall storeys (2 stacks halls and halves the footprint)
storeys.title: Storeys

rack_kw.description: Average IT load per rack, kW
rack_kw.title: Rack Kw

cooling.description: Air on chilled water (air_chw), direct-to-chip liquid with residual air (liquid_dtc) or a mix (hybrid)
cooling.title: Cooling

halls_per_group.description: Halls served by one redundancy group
halls_per_group.title: Halls Per Group

blocks_per_elec_room.description: UPS blocks (lineups) sharing one electrical room
blocks_per_elec_room.title: Blocks Per Elec Room

genset_tiers.description: Gensets stacked in tiers (2 = double-stacked yard)
genset_tiers.title: Genset Tiers

design_pue.description: Override the computed peak PUE for intake and fuel sizing (None = computed, CUN-CAL-PUE-001 method)
design_pue.title: Design Pue

pue_target_peak.description: Client peak PUE target, checked if given
pue_target_peak.title: Pue Target Peak

mech_lineups.description: Mechanical load on the IT lineups (shared, mech_kw_per_lineup each), on dedicated mechanical lineups (separate), or shared when it fits (auto)
mech_lineups.title: Mech Lineups

mech_on_blocks.description: Legacy: False is the same as mech_lineups='separate'
mech_on_blocks.title: Mech On Blocks

genset_lp_1m_dba.description: Genset noise at 1 m all round (70 / 75 / 85 dB(A)); None = record value
genset_lp_1m_dba.title: Genset Lp 1M Dba

fuel_autonomy_h.description: Hours of fuel stored on site at the peak facility load
fuel_autonomy_h.title: Fuel Autonomy H

heat_rejection.description: Heat rejection type; auto = chillers for air cooling, dry coolers first for liquid
heat_rejection.title: Heat Rejection

hr_location.description: Heat rejection on the roof, in a ground yard, or both tried (auto)
hr_location.title: Hr Location

hr_uplift_k.description: Air-on uplift over design ambient for heat rejection in arrays (recirculation), K. Applied to capacity and EER. CUN-CAL-PUE-001 used 5 K (DC01), 2 K (project B)
hr_uplift_k.title: Hr Uplift K

chw_flow_c.description: CHW flow temperature, degC (20-26 typical); sets chiller EER
chw_flow_c.title: Chw Flow C

ambient_design_c.description: Design dry bulb, e.g. N=20 extreme + climate uplift
ambient_design_c.title: Ambient Design C

fwr_c.description: Facility water return temperature to heat rejection, degC
fwr_c.title: Fwr C

yard_barrier_db.description: Attenuation from a barrier round the ground HR yard
yard_barrier_db.title: Yard Barrier Db

building_screen_db.description: Extra attenuation when the building blocks the path
building_screen_db.title: Building Screen Db

profile.description: Client profile id (library pack); sets approved plant, defaults, rules
profile.title: Profile

use_drafts.description: Allow draft/reviewed library records (exploration only; flagged on outputs)
use_drafts.title: Use Drafts

hr_prefer.description: How heat rejection units are ranked: footprint, noise, unit count or a balance
hr_prefer.title: Hr Prefer

hr_unit.description: Force a heat rejection unit (catalogue key / record id)
hr_unit.title: Hr Unit

genset_unit.description: Force a genset (catalogue key / record id)
genset_unit.title: Genset Unit

tx_unit.description: Force a transformer (catalogue key / record id)
tx_unit.title: Tx Unit

overrides.description: Catalogue overrides for this project, e.g. {'halls.corridor_depth': 5.0, 'halls.cross_corridor_every': 1, 'egress.plant_room_exits': true}
overrides.title: Overrides
